name: Sacred Cloth
label: Quest
description: Sacred Cloth: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Although the people of Timbermaw delight in the feel of runecloth, it is not sacred to us. But mooncloth is sacred.
Bring me a small supply of this holy cloth, and I will teach you a secret fashioning technique.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Have you brought the mooncloth, friend?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Ah, very good. This mooncloth will be used for garments sacred to our people. Thank you, friend. Now I will train you.
